checks.evidence: verify defaults: all PASS (finite, peak -3.00 dBFS, silent_edges, dc -165 dB, 4 macro claims, rebuild bit-identical). No FAIL.

time_shape.evidence: 0.761 s (brief 0.6-1.8 s), attack 1 ms (burst at t=0), -20 dB at 0.15 s, -60 dB at 0.42 s, 1 onset (bubbles merge under 40 ms; density 9 events/s). Tail rings to ~0.7 s then 58 ms silence.

spectrum.evidence: Centroid falls as briefed: 483 / 121 / 104 Hz (start/middle/end), by tenth 1.09k -> 254 -> 193 -> 120 -> 99. But the burst is thin: first fifth has 8k+ at -31 dB and 4k at -34 dB, whole-sound shares 2k-8k 1%, >8k 0%, and the burst is gone by ~20 ms in the picture. The tail sits entirely under ~250 Hz (63-125 Hz bands, a 114 Hz mode, 0.41 s, -10 dB) with nothing above 500 Hz after 40% of the sound; peak loudness is at 0.33 s (the low plop), not the burst. Reads as thud plus low blob more than a broadband splash with a bubbly tail.

parts.evidence: Burst visible as a vertical broadband streak up to 16k in the first ~20 ms of the spectrogram (onset centroid 854 Hz, 0.75 ms attack). Bubbles visible as falling pitch glides 286 -> 100 Hz (pitch by tenth) with waveform bumps from 0.05-0.30 s, and a distinct large low plop at ~0.38 s (114 Hz). Burst and tail are separately visible.

control_variation.evidence: 4 macros (brightness, size, weight, splashiness), every claim PASSes in verify (e.g. size decay 0.10 -> 0.80 s; weight centroid 1.2k -> 283 Hz). Seeds 1-4 differ: LUFS -18.6/-17.6/-16.9/-21.3, start centroid 483/429/467/513 Hz, bubble density 6/6/5/10 events, different waveform bumps; all stay inside the brief (length 0.761 s, 1 onset, falling centroid, middle 117-121, end 104-105 Hz).

notes: Seed variation is modest: the big 114 Hz plop at ~0.38 s and the middle/end centroids (117-121 / 104-105 Hz) are almost identical across seeds; only the early bubble pattern and level change.

Macro extremes break the brief's burst: brightness 0 or splashiness 0 give attack 0.33 s (peak at the plop, no burst); weight 0 drops loudness to -28 LUFS (crest 24 dB) and adds 22 events; weight 0.5 -> 1 changes almost nothing (whole centroid 316 -> ~286 Hz).

Overall tail is very low in pitch (bubble pitch 100-290 Hz, i.e. large bubbles); bubbles in water splashes typically sit higher, so the tail may read as a thump rather than bubbling (unheard, measured only).
